author: tbolt
description: A lean, local-first bullion ledger. Track coins, bars, and rounds, weigh and reconcile them against spot, refresh prices from live feeds or an AI agent, and log supplies. Data lives on your NAS.

tips.before_install:
## Reserve Ledger

Data (holdings, custom metals, spot prices, feeds, supplies) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/reserve-ledger/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Reserve Ledger
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted bullion ledger with on-NAS storage.
